cases.title: The Missing Mascot
cases.summary: The school mascot has vanished before an assembly. Follow the clues and discover what happened.

cases.title: The Library Lockdown
cases.summary: A storm, a locked library, and a coded catalog reveal the truth behind a missing rare atlas.

cases.title: The Olympian Artifact
cases.summary: A vanished bronze medallion, a fictional mountain myth, and conflicting interpretations lead detectives from an ancient inscription to modern preservation records.

cases.title: The Underground Blackout
cases.summary: An underground lighting outage sparks conflicting accounts. Compare clock readings, witness testimony, and maintenance records to identify an accidental safety shutdown.

cases.title: The Vanishing Esports Trophy
cases.summary: Before the esports awards, a vanished trophy, an old bracket, and an oddly timed photo spark rumors. Follow authentic tournament and custody records to uncover a routine engraving transfer.

cases.title: The Orchard Ledger
cases.summary: A 48-crate apple donation goes missing at a fictional Naches Valley orchard. Compare lot tags, dispatch sheets, printer logs, and cooler records to solve the labeling mix-up.

cases.title: The Desert Camp Cipher
cases.summary: A missing desert research sample, cryptic field symbols, and a flashback notebook demand two timelines: a 2018 shelter move and a 2026 conservation transfer.

cases.title: The Memory Archive
cases.summary: An edited oral-history exhibit misattributes a flood warning. Trace firsthand logs, protecting a witness, and an intact recording to reconcile privacy with truthful public memory.

cases.title: The Vanishing Forest Robot
cases.summary: A forest-monitoring robot goes silent during a flood warning. Compare wildlife tracks, telemetry, a misleading photo, and signed equipment records to find its safe new location.

cases.title: The Hidden Inheritance
cases.summary: A retired inventor’s cryptic bequest pits family expectations against gallery publicity. Follow signed records and delivery receipts to discover the recipient of 24 teaching machines.

cases.title: The Dragon Council
cases.summary: Three dragon clans suspect one another when their peace letter misses its public reading. Reconcile storm signals, biased testimony, courier records, and neutral custody to reconstruct its safe detour.

cases.title: The Stormbound Expedition
cases.summary: A mountain expedition searches the wrong grid square for emergency supplies. Compare a signed cache receipt, a smudged route map, and storm-time journals to unravel the mix-up.

cases.title: The Secret Academy
cases.summary: At Emberrise Academy, a secret first-letter message appears in experiment reports. Separate copying errors from an intentional safety warning through timestamps, lab readings, and close reading.

cases.title: The School Time Capsule
cases.summary: A school’s time-capsule letter has two missing pages. Compare a prewritten yearbook caption, a repeated newspaper claim, and signed 1999 custody records to discover a forgotten conservation transfer.

cases.title: The Painted Replica
cases.summary: Two identically titled paintings spark a forgery rumor. Compare original artwork notes, replica permissions, a mistaken exhibit label, and signed conservation records to locate a protected original.

cases.title: The Midnight Radio Signal
cases.summary: A midnight verse on Wrenfall radio sounds like a distress message. Compare figurative language, a fast studio clock, storm records, and authenticated relay logs to uncover an accidental emergency-test rebroadcast.

cases.title: The Trail Journal
cases.summary: Conflicting trail journal entries point toward a seasonal path adjustment.
